title: Key-talent attrition above threshold at 90 days
notes: Design §B.4: key-talent attrition tracked at 30/60/90 in phase 3; crossing the 90-day threshold escalates to the risk officer. The threshold value is ILLUSTRATIVE until the thresholds meeting (ADR-0052 open question c). Declared in YAML, not yet executable — predicate null by design (activation convention per ADR-0057).
